coverage_notes.exclusions: Search results were stale (2022-2026 pre-window), unrelated, outside the United States, or not actual food-access disruptions. An October 2026 report on Safeway exiting Arvada, CO did not qualify: alternate grocers remain and shutdown is scheduled November 14.
coverage_notes.verification_limitations: Search indexing and first-publication timestamps may lag the ~one-hour recall window; no claim of exhaustive nationwide coverage.
